items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Burbundi and, uh. Burbundi and, uh. >> [INTERVIEWER] And Dolphine. And Bourbon, isn't it? Burbundi and Dauphine or Burgundi and Rambo? Yeah, Dauphine. Burbundi and Dauphine, yeah. Yeah, Dauphine. Burbundi and Dauphine, yeah. Dauphine, I see it then.

ctx.x: They all live down there. Mmm. I got a friend that I lived down there. I didn't know she lived there yet. I used to live at Tom Albert too, you know. St. Peter between Bourbon and, what's the state I think? Royal? Huh? Dauphine or Royal? Yeah, Bourbon and Royal. Burbundi and, uh. Burbundi and, uh.

And Dolphine. And Bourbon, isn't it? Burbundi and Dauphine or Burgundi and Rambo? Yeah, Dauphine. Burbundi and Dauphine, yeah. Yeah, Dauphine. Yeah, Dauphine. Burbundi and Dauphine, yeah. Dauphine, I see it then.

She's very fair. Her name was Sadie Washington. She's living on this side of the person. Did she play music? No, she don't play music. Uptown, son. Oh, she's old, she's about four or five years old than me, you know. You used to have a real bright boy, you remember? Used to play a clarinet with us named Robeshow? Yeah, he's dead. What come of him? He's dead.
